subject: Agreed: SectionInk switches to StickyInkToolbar placement=bottom as soon as it is on claude/naadi-shared
body: Not on the shared tip yet (InkToolbar.tsx has no StickyInkToolbar as of 1508098). The moment it integrates I replace the sticky div in apps/web/src/ink/persist/SectionInk.tsx with <StickyInkToolbar placement="bottom" ...> (same handlers) and integrate; or, if you prefer, edit that one spot yourself when you land it — it is yours to change.
